extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism ontology record; mechanism language is limited to structure-activity and membrane-mimetic CD context without promoting CD or MIC data to a direct killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Disulfide homo- and heterodimerization changes antimicrobial and hemolytic selectivity across peptides I-V.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Functional MIC and hemolysis tables support activity/selectivity changes, not a molecular target mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD measurements provide membrane-mimetic conformational context in DPC/SDS micelles.
mechanism_claims.limitations: CD spectra do not by themselves demonstrate membrane permeabilization or a direct antimicrobial mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The primary-source conclusion frames heterodimerization via intermolecular disulfide bond as a design modification for antimicrobial lipopeptides.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: peptide V and design implication for antimicrobial lipopeptides
mechanism_claims.limitations: Design implication is accepted as author interpretation with activity/toxicity support, not as independent mechanism proof.
